m: वि-खाद m. (√ खाद्) devouring, destroying, RV. x, 38, 4 (= संग्राम, Naigh. ii, 17).
वि-˚खादितक n. a dead body which has been devoured by animals, Buddh.
वि-˚खानस m. (prob.) ‘one who digs up (scil. roots)’, N. of a Muni, Śak., Sch. (cf. वैखानस).
विखासा f. the tongue, W.

s: viKaH
tri, (viKyaH । nipAtanAt yalopaH .) gatanAsikaH । iti BaratadvirUpakozaH ॥
v: tri॰ vigatA nAsikA yasya KAdeSaH । gatanAsike । amaraH । KyAdeSaH । viKyo'pyatra trikA॰ ।
m: विख mfn. (prob. वि-ख, also विखु and विख्र), noseless, L.
a: विख — a. Noseless. --Comp. --नस् m. an epithet of Brahman.
विखंडित — p. p. 1 Broken up, divided. --2 Cleft in two. --3 Disfigured, mutilated; Pt. 4. 89. --4 Refuted.

m: वि-˚खण्डिन् mfn. breaking, removing, destroying (enmity), Cat.
वि-खण्डित mfn. (√ खण्ड्) cut into pieces, divided, lacerated, Pañcat.; BhP.
torn asunder, cleft in two, VarBṛS.
disturbed, interrupted, Pur.
refuted, W.
वि-√ खन् P. -खनति, to dig up, AV.

s: viKanAH
[s] puM, brahmA । yaTA, -- “na Kalu gopikAnandano BavAnaKiladehinAmantarAtmadfk । viKanasArTito viSvaguptaye saKa udeyivAn sAttvatAM kule ॥” iti SrIBAgavate । 10 । 31 । 4 ॥

m: वि-˚खनन n. digging up, Nir.
विखनस् m. N. of Brahmā, BhP.
of a Muni (cf. वि-खानस).
वि—खेद mfn. free from weariness, fresh, alert, BhP.
वि-√ खिद् P. -खिदति, to tear asunder, rend apart, ŚāṅkhBr.

s: viKraH
tri, (vigatA nAsikA yasya । “KruKrO ca vaktavyO .” iti nAsikAyA KraH Kru Sca .) anAsikaH । iti hemacandraH ॥ CinnanAsikaH । iti SabdaratnAvalI ॥
m: विख्र or विख्रु. See विख above.
a: विख्र — a. Noseless. --Comp. --नस् m. an epithet of Brahman.

s: viKruH
tri, (vigatA nAsikA yasya । “KruKrO ca vaktavyO .” iti nAsikAyA KraH Kru Sca .) anAsikaH । iti hemacandraH ॥ CinnanAsikaH । iti SabdaratnAvalI ॥
a: विख्रु — a. Noseless. --Comp. --नस् m. an epithet of Brahman.

s: viKuH
tri, (vigatA nAsikA yasya । bahulavacanAt nAsikAyAH KuH .) gatanAsikaH । iti BaratadvirUpakozaH ॥
a: विखु — a. Noseless. --Comp. --नस् m. an epithet of Brahman.

s: viKuraH
puM, rAkzasaH । iti trikARqaSezaH ॥ cOraH । iti saMkziptasAroRAdivfttiH ॥
v: puMstrI॰ 1 rAkzase trikA॰ striyAM NIz । 2 cOre saMkzipta॰
m: वि—खुर m. ‘hoofless’, a goblin, demon, Rākṣasa, L.
वि-खुर वि-खेद. See p. 950.
a: विखुरः — 1 A demon, goblin. --2 A thief.

m: वि-√ ख्या P. -ख्याति (Ved. inf. विख्ये, Pāṇ. iii, 4, 11; वि-ख्यै, RV. x, 158, 4), to look about, look at, view, see, behold, RV.; ŚBr.; to shine, shine upon, lighten, illumine, RV.; AV. : Caus. -ख्यापयति, to show, make visible, ŚBr.; to make known, announce, proclaim, declare, Mn.; MBh.
a: विख्या — {c2c} P. 1 To be well-known or famous. --2 To look at, see. --3 To call, name. --4 To celebrate. --5 To make visible, illuminate. --Caus. To proclaim, announce, publish.

s: viKyApanaM
klI, (vi + KyA + Ric + lyuw .) vyAKyAnam । vipUrvvaYyantaKyADAtoranawpratyayena nizpannam ॥
m: वि-˚ख्यापन n. making known, announcing, publishing, Gaut.
explanation, exposition, W.
avowing, acknowledging, confessing, MW.
a: विख्यापनं — 1 Publishing, proclaiming. --2 Explanation, exposition. --3 Confessing, acknowledging.

s: viKyAtaH
tri, KyAtyApannaH । vipUrvvaKyADAtoH ktapratyayena nizpannaH ॥ (yaTA, mahABArate । 1 । 67 । 32 । “candravarmmeti viKyAtaH kAmbojAnAM narADipaH ॥”)
v: viSezeRa KyAtaH prasidDaH vi + KyA--kta । prasidDe
m: वि-˚ख्यात mfn. generally known, notorious, famous, celebrated, Yājñ.; R. &c.
known as, called, named, MBh.; R.; Hit.
avowed, confessed, W.
a: विख्यात — p. p. 1 Renowned, wellknown, celebrated, famous. --2 Called, named. --3 Avowed, confessed.

s: viKyAtiH
strI, prasidDiH । suKyAtiH । vipUrvvaKyADAtoH ktipratyayena nizpannaH ॥
m: वि-˚ख्याति f. fame, celebrity, renown, R.

s: viKyaH
tri, (vigatA nAsikAsyeti । “KyaSca .” 8 । 4 । 28 । ityasya vArttikoktyA nAsikAyAH KyaH .) gatanAsikaH । iti kecit ॥
a: विख्य — a. Noseless. --Comp. --नस् m. an epithet of Brahman.
